name: Longer Nano Duo AI
tagline: AI-assisted portable Longer with dual laser sources
tldr: Longer Nano Duo AI adds dual-source portability with app AI features for layout and material presets. Niche portable for makers who want Longer branding plus more flexibility than single-beam Nano models.
mainObjective: Smart portable dual-source engraving for travel and small items

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $1,519.99 to $2,119.99 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 2W infrared next to the 20W blue diode: marks metal and plastics on the same machine
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers Longer Nano Duo AI. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Portable dual-source personalization with AI-assisted setup.

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Nano Duo AI (20W diode + 2W IR) suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
